title: Coefficient membership criterion for the coordinate ideal
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, r i natural numbers with 1 ≤ r and i ≤ r, g : Fin i → R, and p : MvPolynomial (Fin r) R. Then p belongs to the ideal spanned by C (g j) * X (Fin.castLE hir j) for j : Fin i if and only if for every E : Fin r →₀ ℕ, coeff E p belongs to the ideal spanned by g '' {j : Fin i | E (Fin.castLE hir j) ≠ 0}.

proof.text: The full coefficient membership argument is a separate intermediate theorem; it expands ideal generators and monomials coefficientwise.

lean.statement: theorem ideal_coefficients_monomial_membership {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (r i : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hir : i ≤ r) (g : Fin i → R) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin r) R) : p ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range fun j : Fin i => C (g j) * X (Fin.castLE hir j)) ↔ ∀ E : Fin r →₀ ℕ, coeff E p ∈ Ideal.span (g '' {j : Fin i | E (Fin.castLE hir j) ≠ 0})
